The data elements for each vaccination event section outlines data that need to have been collected for each vaccination the vaccinated person received (see Table 11). For each dose, all the data elements in Table 11 are required to have been recorded. In paper form, this is equivalent to a separate row on a vaccination certificate that is then repeated for each vaccination received.
